description: This file defines data models for users, items, authentication tokens, and related operations using SQLModel and Pydantic, primarily for database schema and API data validation in a backend application.

classes.name: UserBase
classes.description: Base model for user data with common properties.

classes.name: UserCreate
classes.description: Model for user creation API input.

classes.name: UserRegister
classes.description: Model for user registration API input.

classes.name: UserUpdate
classes.description: Model for updating user data, all fields optional.

classes.name: UserUpdateMe
classes.description: Model for updating current user info.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Database model representing a user, including relationships.

classes.name: UserPublic
classes.description: Public view of user data for API responses.

classes.name: UsersPublic
classes.description: Container for list of public users and count.

classes.name: ItemCreate
classes.description: Model for item creation API input.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: Database model representing an item, including relationships.

classes.name: ItemPublic
classes.description: Public view of item data for API responses.

classes.name: ItemsPublic
classes.description: Container for list of public items and count.

classes.name: NewPassword
classes.description: Model for password reset token and new password.
